A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 52-page versions of AgentAuditor. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–S support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark evaluations, component ablations, robustness experiments, resource measurements, and human evaluations in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons in Tables 1, 12–13 and human evaluations in Appendix Q.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same feature-memory construction, FINCH-based representative selection, CoT memory generation, and staged retrieval procedure. The appendix algorithms and prompts are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same four ASSEBench subsets, source benchmarks, and eight evaluation datasets in Appendix K. The adversarial, cross-dataset, and retrieval-quality scenarios in Appendix O are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 12–13 retain the same ten base LLMs, ShieldAgent, and Llama-Guard-3. Comparator membership in the embedding, clustering, and other appendix comparisons also remains unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported prompts, memory-case exclusion, N=8 and K=3 retrieval settings, 512-dimensional embeddings, metrics, and human-evaluation sampling procedures are unchanged. No new evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: The component ablations, embedding and clustering analyses, label-noise tests, adversarial attacks, cross-dataset tests, and retrieval-quality experiments retain the same designs and evidence (Table 2 and Appendices M–O).

E5.justification: Human-evaluator standard-deviation bars in Figure 8 and inter-rater reliability reporting in Appendices J and Q are unchanged, including Krippendorff's alpha of 0.86. No repeated-run or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Corresponding numerical tables and plotted results match throughout both PDFs. For example, Gemini-2 with AgentAuditor retains 96.31 F1 and 96.10 accuracy on R-Judge in Table 1; appendix outcomes also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulations in Section 3, FINCH formalization and algorithms, and metric definitions in Appendix J are retained. No mathematical assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims of a training-free memory-augmented evaluator, joint safety/security benchmarking with ambiguity standards, broad performance improvements, and human-level evaluation performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of component synergy, robustness, resource efficiency, and ShieldAgent discrepancies remain unchanged. Section 6 and the appendices retain the same limitations, applicability boundaries, and broader-impact qualifications.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the advertised repository from AgentAuditor to AgentAuditor-ASSEBench. This revises access information; implementation details remain unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish whether actual resource availability changed.

R1.justification: v3 adds FaintBench, VersusDebias, BigBench, DynamicNER, and EnchTable citations, adjusts citation placement, and connects Appendix P's efficiency discussion to prior methods. Representation Noising receives a publication-reference update rather than becoming a new cited work.

P1.justification: Section 4's introduction of R-Judge is lightly rewritten, Appendix P gains a short comparison phrase, and bibliographic text receives edits. The section order and overall narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: Added references and local text edits cause bibliography reflow and small layout shifts, including Figure 2's position on page 4. All figures and tables retain their content and designs.

improvement.justification: v3 provides limited wording and citation refinements and updates the repository pointer. The method, experimental evidence, uncertainty reporting, technical documentation, and limitations remain substantively unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. These edits establish no meaningful net improvement or deterioration in overall paper quality.
